guide.title: How to use the admin
guide.description: What works today, the shortest path for sellers, and how the chat button opens the right screen.
guide.intro: This pilot stores data locally (SQLite). All create / edit / delete actions use forms on each menu page. The assistant chat **opens the right page** so you can click Save or set status yourself. Full AI actions require OpenClaw when configured.
guide.realtimeHeading: What works in the admin today
guide.realtimeIntro: These areas already have real forms or lists (not only mock content):
realtimeBullets: Overview: four KPIs, recent orders, two DB-fed lists — all from SQLite.
Inbox /admin/inbox: same Task table as the overview widget; Approve → DONE, Reject → IGNORED.
Onboarding & shop settings: name, QR, operating hints.
Products: add / edit / delete / archive / image URL.
Orders: list, create from admin, change status.
Payments: list, update status, bill notes.
Bookings: create / browse by day (?date=), cancel when needed.
Shipping: real per-order notes; carrier list is PRD mock.
Settings: shop summary from DB with link to Onboarding.
Integrations & automation: saved connection state / queue — not full auto-posting yet.
Reports: headline totals + order/payment status counts (live); dashed box = PRD mock; SKU CSV export is live.

botRoadmap.title: Bot & webview direction (future)
botRoadmap.intro: Goal: the assistant maps to this admin surface, then opens webviews/tools for connected systems. Today the pilot only routes inside the app; next steps need APIs and strict trust boundaries.
bullets: Posting / customer care: channel content APIs + approval policy; webview could be Meta / Zalo Business after OAuth.
Orders / QR: forms exist on Orders + Onboarding; a future bot could call scoped server actions via the gateway.
COD shipping: needs carrier adapters + normalized address; today only per-order shipping notes in-app.
Webviews: usually external seller consoles (Shopee, Zalo OA) — watch sessions/cookies and never store passwords in the bot.

laterBullets.body: Integrations save connection state; there is no one-click “post for me” yet. Pilot: compose on the channel or export SKU CSV from Reports.

aiChat.gatewayOffline: OpenClaw AI is **off** — set `NEXT_PUBLIC_GATEWAY_AUTH_TOKEN` in the browser (same value as `GATEWAY_AUTH_TOKEN` in OpenClaw). Legacy `NEXT_PUBLIC_GATEWAY_AUTH_TOKEN` still works. The `/api/gateway` proxy reads `GATEWAY_AUTH_TOKEN` or `OPENCLAW_GATEWAY_TOKEN`. Menus still work; in chat try **products**, **orders**, **onboarding**, or **what works**.
